description: Na₂CdCl₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.95 Å. Cd is bonded to six Cl atoms to form edge-sharing CdCl₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.60 Å) and four longer (2.67 Å) Cd-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Cd atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Cd trigonal bipyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Cd atoms.
